cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I finished one painting for our exhibition. You may now tell me whether it's enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice a gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That plan isn't approved. I asked whether my painting deserves the wall space.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put it in the middle and introduce me as the other painter. No apology for the empty space. I want to hear you say I've done enough.

reason: Rereading found first assessment and assess phrasing unnecessarily abstract for the actual art conversation. Make A permissions govern the concrete wall-space plan and introduction.
